findings.repro: Guest options > Reset guest session > Confirm reset while the reply is replaced by status 200 with an empty body (route.fulfill). Compare: invalid JSON, 429, 500, 503 all show a role=alert with Dismiss
findings.expected: An unreadable/incomplete success reply raises the same alert as the other malformed replies (invariant 7), or at least the app does not claim/act as if the reset happened

findings.fix_hint: web/src/app.tsx:282: normalize the reset reply (rec(reply,'reset') plus the one boolean the server returns, see be/src/routes.ts /demo/reset) before clearing the attempt
